query: What is Midjourney's most recently reported number of registered users, and its most recently reported number of full-time employees? Give each figure with its reporting period and the primary source.
report: Midjourney’s most recently reported number of registered users is approximately 21 million, reported as of mid-2025, sourced from Axis Intelligence Research [1]. Midjourney’s most recently reported number of full-time employees is 165 total employees as of June 2026, sourced from Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data [2].
